acceptance: Add exactly the additive compliance migration (ComplianceProfile, ComplianceFiling) with no changes to existing rows; both models are covered by backup and schema health.

Seed the pure obligation registry from the research table: every key has a source URL, periods are correct for 2026-2028, applies() covers the owner-fact branches, and the not-needed items (BOI, Form 2290, rent-to-own license) carry their reason and source.

Business facts save with the EIN encrypted (AES-256-GCM, version-prefixed); only the last 4 are ever shown; the full EIN never appears in logs, audits, prepared data or exports; a missing encryption key disables the field with the owner checklist row filed.

A filing's approval binds its preparedHash: data changed after preparation forces re-review; approving and submitting happen under the row lock so two concurrent approvals file once only (real-database test).
The filled-form engine verifies each vendored PDF against the manifest hash and fills it through the field map; tests fail if a mapped field is missing from the PDF.
The Compliance screen shows Coming up / Needs you / Done / Not needed with the actOn date from the timing rule, passes the browser spec with axe, and files its To do items under COMPLIANCE_DUE.
invariants: Nothing is submitted or filed without the owner's Approve on the exact prepared numbers; a changed number forces re-review (preparedHash binding).
Tax ids are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), shown only as last 4, decrypted only inside filing preparation, and never appear in logs, audits or exports.
Money stays integer cents; times are stored UTC and shown America/Denver; writes lock the row first and re-check the actor inside the transaction.

No invented rates, dates or legal answers: unverified facts become an owner setting with a careful starting value plus a Decisions question (CMP-ENTITY, CMP-BPP-RENTAL-EXEMPT and the other CMP questions).
Migrations are additive; the registry stays a pure module seeded only from the researched sources in the registry file.
next: Full tests, CI, review, merge; then CMP-3 (1099s and W-9s) on this foundation.
outcome: The Compliance center exists: every federal and Colorado obligation from the research file is in a pure registry with sources and periods for 2026-2028, the owner's business facts are stored with the EIN encrypted (AES-256-GCM, last 4 only), filings move through prepare/approve/submit with the approval bound to the prepared numbers' hash and a single-submission lock, the filled-official-form engine fills vendored PDFs against a hash manifest, and the Compliance screen shows Coming up / Needs you / Done / Not needed.
